description: Fixed replay corpus for Yarnotron latency benchmarking and golden-output diffing. The seed story and the turn list must stay stable: changing either invalidates every recorded baseline and golden response.

seed_story.title: The Lighthouse at Sable Point
seed_story.synopsis: Wren and a stubborn mechanical gull keep the last lighthouse burning through a winter of impossible storms.

characters.name: Wren
characters.notes: Eleven years old. Took over the lighthouse from her grandmother.

characters.name: Barnacle
characters.notes: A clockwork gull who refuses to fly in the rain.

scenes.title: The Light Goes Out
scenes.summary: The lamp fails on the coldest night of the year.

scenes.title: Climbing the Stair
scenes.summary: Wren carries the spare lens up two hundred steps.

facts.text: The lighthouse lamp runs on whale oil and a clockwork turning mechanism.
Barnacle cannot fly in the rain because his wing joints seize.
